operations.actionDetail: A verified observed configuration shows the retention backstop does not hold as generated, so objects can outlive the privacy ceiling. Reconcile the drift.
operations.summary: Operations are critical: a worker cannot run correctly here.

slo.detail: 1 of 12 SLO indicators had enough data to judge; worst observed status is breach.

cleanupEvidence.detail: No content-free cleanup evidence report is configured (or the configured report reports no object storage), so there is nothing to monitor here.

lifecycle.detail: The lifecycle verification subsystem reports drift: the observed retention policy is missing, weaker, or disabled versus the declared one. Reconcile it out-of-band.

pipeline.detail: No cleanup-pipeline summary was supplied, so pipeline posture is not included. Point it at a content-free `pnpm worker:cleanup-pipeline --json` summary to include it.

caveats: This bundle AGGREGATES existing content-free operator signals; it is not itself a new proof.
It is not proof of byte deletion — cleanup evidence attests absence/expiry posture, not that a provider erased bytes.
It is not malware scanning, sanitization, authentication, or authorization of any request.
It does not validate cloud state — it made no network call and read no provider export, secret, bucket, or object.
Every value here is a bounded enum or app-authored prose; it carries no locator, identifier, timestamp, size, or byte.
